As a Hologic Summer Intern, you are not just taking a job; you are taking your place on a global team of motivated, creative, and dedicated people! The intern experience gives you the opportunity to shine and share your knowledge, energy, and passion on meaningful projects that impact people all over the world.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Software Engineer Intern to help design, build, and improve our software. In this role, you will work on writing and testing code, finding and fixing bugs, and supporting our technical infrastructure. You’ll use tools for build pipelines, automated testing, and other cloud-based/web technologies to help deliver reliable, high-quality software.

This is a hands-on role suited for someone who enjoys coding, problem solving, and learning how complex systems are developed in real-world environments.

Throughout the 10-12 weeks you'll have the opportunity to participate in the following:

• Design and develop code and documentation to support the creation of new features and functionality.

• Develop and maintain software under an Agile/Scrum/Continuous Integration methodology.

• Develop required software tests to ensure features are properly verified.

• Participate in troubleshooting of defects.

• Learn, apply, and share knowledge of new and emerging technologies and the opportunities to integrate them into our products.

We're looking for bright, inquisitive problem solvers who strive to make a difference. Key qualifications include the following:

• Able to work full-time over the summer months (May/June – August/ Sept)

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Programming experience with .NET/C#, C++, or similar (coursework or projects acceptable).

• Basic understanding of:

• Computer science concepts (operating systems, databases, software systems, and networking).

• Software design principles, algorithms, data structures, design patterns.

• Experience with source control tools (e.g., Git).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work onsite at our Newark, DE campus. Intern housing, relocation, and housing stipends are not provided.

The hourly pay range for this role is $23-$28 per hour. The compensation depends on the Educational Standing/Graduation Year.

Hologic, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer inclusive of disability and veterans.

Why choose between doing meaningful work and having a fulfilling life? At MITRE, you can have both. That's because MITRE people are committed to tackling our nation's toughest challenges—and we're committed to the long-term well-being of our employees. MITRE is different from most technology companies. We are a not-for-profit corporation chartered to work for the public interest, with no commercial conflicts to influence what we do. The R&D centers we operate for the government create lasting impact in fields as diverse as cybersecurity, healthcare, aviation, defense, and enterprise transformation. We're making a difference every day—working for a safer, healthier, and more secure nation and world. Our workplace reflects our values. We offer competitive benefits, exceptional professional development opportunities for career growth, and a culture of innovation that embraces adaptability, collaboration, technical excellence, and people in partnership. If this sounds like the choice you want to make, then choose MITRE - and make a difference with us.

NOTE: Thank you for your interest in MITRE’s internship opportunities. Please be aware that this is not an application for a specific position. By submitting your information and providing your resume, you will be included in a pool of candidates for various internship roles across the company. If you are selected for consideration for a particular internship, a member of MITRE’s Student Programs team will reach out to you. The primary hiring season for MITRE internships runs from September through March. You can monitor your application status here: Workday (myworkdayjobs.com).

Job Description

As a software or computer science intern, you will collaborate with a team of experts to apply your academic knowledge and gain hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
• Front-End, Back-End, Middleware, or Full-Stack Software Development
• Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML)
• Cybersecurity Software Development
• DevSecOps
• Mobile Computing
• Embedded Systems and Internet of Things (IoT)
• Human Factors Engineering, Human-Computer Integration, Human-in-the-Loop Testing, User Experience/User Interface (UX/UI)
• Modeling and Simulation
• Model-Based Engineering
• Virtual Reality (VR)

Basic Qualifications
• Must be a full-time student pursuing an accredited degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related disciplines.
• Must continue to be enrolled the semester following the internship.
• Foundational knowledge of computer science and/or software engineering methodologies, frameworks, tools and/or programming languages.
• Must have sustained excellence in academic performance.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience having applied computer science and/or software engineering learning to an internship, research or lab setting.
• Proficiency using computer science and software engineering methodologies, frameworks, tools and/or programming languages.
• Demonstrated interest in serving the public through previous work experience, volunteer activities, or other relevant engagements.

Job Summary

We invest heavily in new talent. Your energy and fresh ideas are vital to cementing our position as a market -leader. We’ll push you beyond your comfort zone with a belief that no idea is off-limits. At the same time, you’ll have all the resources, mentoring and feedback you need to grow. What’s more, whatever your role, you can be yourself in a team that celebrates individuality and welcomes different perspectives.

As an Intern - Software Engineer (Systems), you would participate in product design, development, verification, troubleshooting, and delivery of a system or major subsystems for our flagship storage operating system, ONTAP. These positions require individuals to be creative, team-oriented, technology savvy, driven to produce results and demonstrates the ability to take a cross-team leadership role.

About ONTAP: ONTAP is a powerful platform known for its advanced data management capabilities, supporting mission-critical applications worldwide. As an Intern - Software Engineer (Systems), you will be part of a talented team responsible for developing, testing, and debugging software that powers NetApp’s cloud, hybrid-cloud, and on-premises solutions.

Essential Functions:
• Collaborate with the team on new feature development and engineering escalations
• Participate in all phases of the product development cycle: definition, design, implementation, debugging, testing, and early customer support
• Work closely with team members and other teams to understand customer needs and deliver solutions
• Solve technical issues collaboratively with other engineers

Job Requirements

Our intern work differs depending on the team and project work but some potential areas of focus and skill sets are:
• Basic knowledge of system software design and development
• Hands-on experience with C and C++
• Familiarity with Unix/Linux System Programming and Multithreaded programming
• Understanding of OS internals, algorithms, and data structures
• Experience in the Storage Domain is a plus

Other helpful skillsets:
• Projects, experiences, or coursework related to areas such as: Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Multi-Threading, Data Structures & Algorithms
• Proven aptitude for learning new technologies
• Creative and analytical approach problem solving skills
• Strong oral and written communication is necessary for success
• Ability to work on a diverse team or with a diverse range of people

Education

Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or enrolled in a related professional program through the summer of 2026.

Compensation:
Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your Role at Baxter

As a Baxter R&D Co-op , you will contribute directly to our mission to empower clinicians and health systems with tools to make a difference in patients and clinicians' lives. It's ambitious work—and you're not on your own.

We are an innovation team within the Baxter FLC group charged with creating the next generation of medical devices and monitors. We are seeking co-ops to help us research and innovate product ideas based on improving care by saving and sustaining lives.

Your Team

You will be a part of the FLC Exam Diagnostics group, which supports both new product development projects and sustainment of currently marketed products. You will work with a cross functional team that consists of other engineering disciplines, operations, and quality assurance. We work together to develop, test, and launch products that improve patient care.

We encourage partnership, collaboration and prioritize building relationships with each other. Our teams support innovation and out-of-the-box thinking balanced with shared expertise and accountability.

What you'll be doing
• Support the project team by participating and assisting in the building and operation of prototypes with the goal of developing new futuristic products.
• Create and complete hardware builds and perform testing.
• Support testing and development of Biomedical test systems for product development
• Research and Test Technologies from many industries to support our future medical products in vital signs
• Follow company processes, while communicating and working on a team to meet project schedules.
• Participate in team meetings to drive innovation and overcome hurdles.

What you'll bring
• Bachelor’s Degree in progress (Electrical, Software Engineering , Biomedical or comparable technical subject area).
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with others multi-functionally
• Strategic problem solver; also execute with excellent attention to detail
• Organization & ability to progress on many different tasks in parallel
• Adaptability, open to change and continuously looks for ways to improve and simplify sophisticated work
• Ability to write code/scripts in Python (preferably), or any other programming languages, like Java, C#, etc.

Baxter is committed to supporting the needs for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a required minimum number of days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in-person in support of our Mission. The flexible workplace policy is subject to local laws and legal requirements. At its discretion, Baxter may decide to adjust, suspend, or discontinue as business needs change.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all our employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. To that end, this position has a pay rate of $26.00 - $28.00 an hour.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Position Summary

As a member of a collaborative development team, the Software Engineer Intern will be involved in developing solutions and applications specializing in Cybersecurity for the Financial Services market. This engineering focus will be geared towards supporting the existing Thales product portfolio, which is best in class, as well as next generation products currently in development.

Additionally, the Junior Engineer will be a contributor in the refactoring of an embedded software baseline onto a platform containing new systems, hardware, software, and security architectures for the next generation product offering.

The Engineering Intern will work closely with systems, software, security, and test engineers (both onsite and remote) to ensure timely delivery of quality products.

Special Position Requirements

Core Business Hours Monday-Friday.

The working environment is generally indoors in environmentally controlled conditions where lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous conditions.

Follow software engineering principles and best practices across all phases of commercial development and engineering product release.

Debug and resolve problems with limited scope in multi-threaded and concurrent applications.

Any other duties or tasks as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

Skills and Abilities:

Understanding of JIRA, GIT, and Bitbucket.

Experience with Linux and Linux virtual machines.

Strong skills in Python and C/C++ programming languages.

Knowledge of REST APIs.

Strong communication and presentation skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and make decisions with supervisory review.

Computer Science or Computer Engineering student, Junior year or above.

Familiar with Agile and/or SAFE methodologies.
Familiar with Qualys tool.

Understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment processes.

Job Description See what you’re missing. Our employees work on the world’s most advanced electronics – from detecting threats for F-35 pilots to illuminating the night for soldiers. Spanning air, land, sea, and space, we are developing the technology of tomorrow, delivered today. Drawing strength from our differences, we are innovating for the future. And you can, too! Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We protect Those Who Protect Us®.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems.

In Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (C4ISR) Systems, you will help develop systems that sense, control, exploit and disseminate actionable information to warfighters supporting a variety of missions. The C4ISR Systems line of business within the Electronic Systems (ES) Sector of BAE Systems is looking for Software Engineering Interns. Individuals who are looking for a company that fosters a work environment in which technical excellence and a strong work ethic is highly valued. If you are a qualified candidate who loves to develop software and continuously expand your skillset, this is the career opportunity for you. The BAE Rome NY campus, established in 1997, provides technical support across multiple ES Sector projects providing both operations and sustainment support to existing efforts and cutting edge solutions for emerging products.

As a Software Engineer Intern, you can expect to gain a breadth of experience working on cross-functional teams under the guidance of Senior Level Engineering. Our Software Engineer Interns have the opportunity to assist in design and development of software platforms and mission applications and will work in a rapid development environment as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Assigned tasks will be technically challenging, achievable, time-boxed, and under the direction of technical leadership. Duties will include analyzing, developing, debugging, testing, configuring, and deploying software solutions in an agile continuous development environment. Applying state-of-the-art software development tools and techniques, working alongside other highly motivated engineers. The Java programming language is the norm for the majority of ES projects. However, many other technologies are typically used as well (e.g. Java, JavaScript, Web Services, SOA, Python, PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, etc.).

Because of the need for consistent, in-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed full-time on site. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time. To allow employees to balance their work and personal lives, we offer flexible “9/80” work schedules, where employees work nine-hour days with every other Friday off within a two-week pay period.Required Education, Experience, & Skills
• Enrollment in a BS/BA, or MS/MA engineering/technical degree program
• Entering Junior or Senior level year (BS/BA) or MS/MA student
• Ability to obtain an active Top Secret/SCI clearance. The applicant must be able to maintain their security clearance for the position. Applicant must also be able to obtain and maintain the CompTIA Security+ certification.
• Basic understanding of standard software skills in design and code
• Exposure to multiple high level programming languages (e.g., Java/J2EE, C/C++)
• Exposure to various scripting languages – JavaScript, Python, PHP
• Exposure to UNIX / Linux / Windows based development environments
• Exposure to data structures, software design patterns and multiple programming language features
• Team player with a proactive attitude and the ability to be productive in a dynamic environment
• Ability to work in a collaborative environment (open seating arrangement)
• Strong oral and written communications skills
• Ability to take initiative, multi-task and work well under pressure
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills
• Applicants with a current TS/SCI security clearance
• Applicants with a current CompTIA Security+ certification
• Experience developing with Java, Java EE, C/C++, Web Services, SOA
• Experience with Cloud Computing, Angular Framework, Perl, JSON, HTML/CSS
• Experience with build systems, such as Make, Ant, Maven and Gradle
• Experience with version control systems, such as Subversion and GIT
• Experience developing web-based graphical user interfaces (GUI) and applications
• Experience implementing software designs as a member of a development team
• Technical writing skills: capable of creating and modifying engineering documentation
• Familiarity with Agile methodology principles

Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

Job Description The BAE Systems IT Internship Program provides a broad and integrated understanding of enterprise level service delivery. The program consists of a 12-week hands-on experience with mentors and Service Leaders. There are multiple positions available to fulfill the following skillsets: software development, building reusable automation, system architecture, data engineering, software development, graphic user interface design, end to end user experience, and other project related work.

As an intern you will participate in our nationwide Internship & Co-Op Program, LEAP, where you will have the opportunity to Learn, Engage, Apply, and Progress within the company. You will also have access to additional benefits such as, networking with BAE Systems employees and other students, participating in exciting real world projects, joining exclusive informational sessions with senior leaders, and expanding mentorship opportunities and career development.

This is an internship during the summer of 2026, and interns should expect the duration to be 12 weeks. Based on performance during the summer session, and with the discretion of the leadership team, there is a possibility of extending the internship to part time during the school year.

The ideal intern should be able to perform the following tasks:
• Perform data analysis and extract useful business insights
• Identify actionable insights, suggest recommendations and help influence the direction of the business by communicating results to cross-functional groups
• Suggest improvements in the tools and techniques to help scale the team
• Experience working in an agile environment, with distributed teams
• Help develop internal wiki for cross-training within SharePoint/Teams
The Internship consists of the following components
• Program Length – 12 Weeks – commitment required for the full 12-week program
• Internship Dates – May 26th – August 14th, 2026
• Hybrid work environment with 3 days per week onsite at a BAE Systems site of Nashua, NH.
• Student Status – Rising Junior, Senior, Recent Graduate (within one year) or Graduate Student (Graduating May or Dec.)
• Compensation – The internship is paid on an hourly basis.
Required Education, Experience, & Skills
• Major Degree – Computer Science / Information Technology / Cybersecurity / Data Science / Information Systems
• Experience in solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches (or equivalent)
• Curious, self-driven, analytical and excited to play with data
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment
• Student Status – Rising Junior, Senior, Recent Graduate (within one year) or Graduate Student (Graduating May or Dec.)
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Well qualified candidates contain some of the following skills:
• Knowledge of security tools such as Splunk, ArcSight, Nessus Security Center, CrowdStrike, CyberArk, etc
• Comfortable performing system administration on a shell/command line interface
• Development experience in at least one scripting language (R, Python, Bash, Java, PowerShell, etc.)
• Update and validate the Software install\support documents
• Familiarity Software development lifecycle to: gather requirements, refine design, build, verify build and validate build
• Familiarity with eDirectory, Identity Management Concepts, DevSecOps Environments, Linux OS, or Active Directory
• Familiarity with one or more UNIX operating systems, such as RedHat
• Experience with User Interface redesigning, wireframing, free hand mockups, and testing practices
• Collaboration skills with UX Designer, Content Strategist, UX Writer, Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Developers
• Machine Learning experience
• Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work, as required, to meet dynamic customer service environment.
• Excellent Customer service skills at all levels
